title: Mixedness of real sheaves by reduction to the proved curve case
statement:
Every constructible $\iota$-real $\Qlb$-Weil sheaf on a separated
finite-type scheme over a finite field is $\iota$-mixed, with a
finite filtration in the sense of [def-weil-punctual-weights].

proof.text: For a real classical lisse $\mathcal G$ on a nonempty smooth geometrically connected affine base of positive dimension, [lem-zl-geometric-constituents-any-base] gives a geometric-constituent filtration after a finite constant extension. Smoothness survives by [lem-pc-proper-base-change](2); affineness and geometric connectedness survive by the affine tensor presentation and the unchanged geometric fibre. [lem-zl-classical-weil-filtration-heart-transport] makes it an actual exact filtration in the constructible Weil heart. Reality survives by [lem-zl-constant-extension-mixed-descent]. By the current [def-wf-iota-real] definition, this is the statement that each local characteristic factor has real coefficients, equivalently that its Frobenius eigenvalue multiset is stable under complex conjugation; the cited extension lemma applies to this precise notion.

[lem-zl-two-point-curve-constituent-purity] makes every nonzero quotient pure with its fixed-anchor weight. The finite filtration is mixed by [def-weil-punctual-weights], with the maximum of its finitely many weights (bound $0$ if empty). Descend the extension by [lem-zl-constant-extension-mixed-descent]. This proves the positive-dimensional lisse case.

For the given $\mathcal F$ on arbitrary $X_0$, restrict to the reduction; [lem-zl-immersion-weil-local-behavior](1) preserves constructibility and reality. [lem-zl-raw-heart-adic-lisse-stratification] supplies a finite adapted partition of its reduced geometric base. Apply [lem-zl-smooth-affine-frontier-stratification] to obtain over one $k_m$ a finite reduced closed chain with open differences finite disjoint unions of smooth geometrically connected affine pieces refining that partition.

Every piece has a classical lisse Weil restriction by [lem-zl-raw-heart-adic-lisse-stratification]: all inclusions are over the same $k_m$. It is real by [lem-zl-constant-extension-mixed-descent] and [lem-zl-immersion-weil-local-behavior](1). Positive-dimensional pieces are mixed by Steps 1-2. A zero-dimensional piece is $\operatorname{Spec}k_m$ by [lem-zl-smooth-affine-frontier-stratification], and is mixed by [lem-zl-point-weil-heart-flag], including nonsemisimple Frobenius.

Apply [lem-zl-reduced-frontier-mixed-gluing] to $X_0\times_{k_0}k_m$ and the mixed component restrictions. It gives a finite mixed Weil filtration on that entire scheme, including recovery from its reduction. [lem-zl-constant-extension-mixed-descent] descends it to $\mathcal F$ on $X_0$. The empty scheme and zero sheaf are included in these two lemmas.
